applies_to: Every implementation pull request for the #309 multi-scenario epic and its child issues, and any other change that opts in by referencing this file. It does not replace AGENTS.md, the Task Packet validator, or protected-branch review.

grants: a reviewer-facing statement that the committed readiness fields are present
a deterministic reproduction of that statement by a command
does_not_grant: authority to waive a required check or human approval

required_sections.heading: Related Issue
required_sections.reason: A change without an issue has no agreed acceptance criteria to check.

required_sections.heading: What changed
required_sections.reason: A reviewer must be able to read the intent without opening the diff first.

required_sections.heading: Interfaces affected
required_sections.reason: AGENTS.md routes interface changes to three human approvals, so an empty answer must be explicit rather than implied.

required_sections.heading: Tests and commands
required_sections.reason: Every deterministic behaviour change needs a command and its recorded result.

required_sections.heading: Failure path exercised
required_sections.reason: A change that only shows the happy path has not shown that the new rejection fires.

required_sections.heading: Evidence
required_sections.reason: AGENTS.md forbids claiming completion without a command, a result and an evidence reference.

required_sections.heading: Risks and rollback
required_sections.reason: A reviewer needs the disable path before the change lands, not after it breaks.

required_checklist.item: I changed only the paths the Task Packet allows.
required_checklist.reason: The Task Packet is the write boundary for the change.

required_checklist.item: The Task Packet matches the final diff.
required_checklist.reason: A packet that describes a different change than the diff is not a contract.

required_checklist.item: Tests and contract checks pass on this commit.
required_checklist.reason: Passing checks on an earlier commit do not describe this one.

required_checklist.item: I covered normal and failure behaviour.
required_checklist.reason: Fail-closed boundaries are the point of this repository.

required_checklist.item: I updated examples and docs when an interface changed.
required_checklist.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md requires the schema, the model, the example and the docs to move together.

required_checklist.item: I did not add secrets, private data or unreviewed assets.
required_checklist.reason: SECURITY.md forbids committing credentials and licence-encumbered assets.

forbidden_claims.reason: A readiness verdict never authorises an automatic merge.
forbidden_claims.sample_violation: This pull request merges automatically once the checks pass.

forbidden_claims.reason: This checklist does not grant release authority; release eligibility is owned by tools/scripts/release_eligibility.py.
forbidden_claims.sample_violation: The change is approved for release once review completes.

forbidden_claims.reason: Only attested hardware evidence may claim physical validation, and this checklist produces none.
forbidden_claims.sample_violation: The controller behaviour is physically validated by this simulation run.

forbidden_claims.reason: A checklist item cannot waive a required check or a required human approval.
forbidden_claims.sample_violation: Ticking this checklist waives the required review.

required_issue_sections.heading: Owner
required_issue_sections.reason: A task without a named human owner and reviewer has no one accountable for the acceptance decision.

required_issue_sections.heading: Problem and objective
required_issue_sections.reason: An issue that cannot state the problem it removes cannot be checked for usefulness.

required_issue_sections.heading: Allowed paths
required_issue_sections.reason: AGENTS.md bounds every AI write by a path list; an issue that omits it defers the boundary to the implementer.

required_issue_sections.heading: Interfaces affected
required_issue_sections.reason: Interface changes route to three human approvals, so an empty answer must be explicit rather than implied.

required_issue_sections.heading: Acceptance criteria
required_issue_sections.reason: Criteria must be stated before coding so 'done' is not redefined afterwards.

required_issue_sections.heading: Commands and evidence
required_issue_sections.reason: AGENTS.md forbids claiming completion without a command, a result and an evidence artifact.

required_issue_sections.heading: Definition of Ready
required_issue_sections.reason: The readiness question list names the rollback or disable path, which a reviewer needs before work starts.

required_issue_sections.heading: Exit Gate
required_issue_sections.reason: The closing conditions must name at least one failure path, and they must be listed before work starts.

required_issue_sections.heading: Dependencies and stop conditions
required_issue_sections.reason: A blocked issue must name what unblocks it so it is not started on a guess.
